title: E0028: Data Class
plain_english: Reports classes, traits, or enums that primarily expose data through getters/setters with little or no behavior.
why_matters: A data-only class can push behavior into other parts of the codebase, making related logic scattered and harder to maintain. Adding meaningful behavior can improve encapsulation and clarity.
what_it_checks: Counts fields and methods in classes, traits, and enums.
Classifies accessor methods (`get*`, `is*`/`has*`, `set*`) using naming and simple body rules.
Ignores classes with no fields or fewer than `min_methods` methods.
Reports `E0028:data-class` when all non-constructor, non-accessor behavior is absent.
